title: Treating cavities in baby teeth
what: The dentist cleans out the hole in a baby tooth and puts in a filling. This keeps the tooth until it is replaced by a permanent one.
why: When a baby tooth has a cavity: a dark spot, a hole, or your child complains of pain.
tell_doctor: Your child's allergies, especially to painkillers
Long-term illnesses and medicines they take
How your child handled treatment before
If your child is very afraid, the doctor will find an approach

prepare.title: Mood
prepare.text: Tell your child calmly that the doctor will count and clean their teeth. Do not scare them with injections or pain.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Feed your child 1 to 2 hours before the visit.

prepare.title: Timing
prepare.text: Choose a time when your child is usually alert, not just before sleep.

bring: A list of medicines, if your child takes any
steps: Your child sits in the chair and meets the instruments
If needed, numbing is given, first a gel and then an injection
The cavity is cleaned out with a drill or hand tools
A filling is placed and fitted to the bite
feel: The noise and vibration of the drill may be scary
After the injection, the lip and cheek are numb for 1 to 2 hours
after: Do not feed your child until the numbness is gone, as they may bite their cheek
Make sure they do not bite or rub the numb lip
Brush teeth as usual in the evening
Come for a check-up at the time your doctor sets
red_flags: Severe pain or a swollen cheek
A fever over 38°C (100.4°F) with a swollen face

faq.q: Why treat a baby tooth if it will fall out?
faq.a: A diseased tooth can hurt, become inflamed, and damage the permanent tooth underneath.

faq.q: What if my child is afraid?
faq.a: Tell the doctor beforehand. Meeting the office and a short first visit often help.

reminders.text: Your child's dental treatment is tomorrow. Feed them 1 to 2 hours before, and bring a favorite toy.
